decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans numbered Covering letter, Specification of Repair Works, Design and Access Statement, Photo Montage, Drawing Numbers 157001, 157002, 157003, 157004, 157005, 157006, 157007, 157008 received 14/07/11, submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and in accordance with the conditions below, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All existing architectural features including staircases, balustrades, windows, doors, architraves, skirtings, dados, picture rails, panel work, and other decorative features shall be retained except where otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No works shall take place until samples of all of the materials (including the steel grandstand beams, concrete, louvers, carbonation coating, rendering, paint, the roof covering and windows and doors) to be used in the repairs hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details.
description:
Repairs to listed building comprising:- 
-Repair of steel windows and timber external doors
-Repair of concrete structure
-Removal of seating
-Recovering the roof
-Installing ventilation louvres
-Replacing broken glazing
-Repairing lightning protection system
-Redecoration of the exterior
